prompts.title: Form Guide — Kinetic Type into Grouped Count Bars
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 stage on GoatLab charcoal #101412. Keep the lower quarter clear for permanent yellow subtitles at all times. EDITORIAL — 'Forma reciente': kinetic typography block. Spanish team labels 'Tottenham Hotspur FC' and 'Coventry City FC' slam in from opposite edges in warm white #edf0e6 condensed caps, each landing with a lime #c5ed74 underline whip. Rhythmic emphasis: the words 'VICTORIAS', 'EMPATES', 'DERROTAS' pulse on a beat grid, scaling up with a 2-frame overshoot and alternating lime and slate #8ca6bf fills; small slate Spanish captions 'ultimos partidos' and 'local / visitante' drift behind. One focal point: the word currently pulsing, while all other type drops to low opacity. Camera: slow push-in with a 1-frame shake on each beat. No axes, no numbers, no sample claims, no invented match events. Exit: the three words collapse and stretch into a single lime horizontal rule. STATISTICAL — 'Resultados por equipo': the lime rule becomes the shared zero baseline of a grouped count bar chart. Three Spanish category clusters 'Victorias', 'Empates', 'Derrotas'; within each cluster two bars, home in lime and away in slate, mapped by a warm-white legend using full Spanish team names. Common scale starts at zero and tops at the largest value among {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}, with the unit 'partidos' at the axis head. Value tags render {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}} for the home club and {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}} for the away club. Sample annotation under each legend entry: 'Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos' and 'Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos', so any difference in sample size is visible; source line 'Fuente: Bzzoiro' in small slate type. Temporal stages: bars grow cluster by cluster (0-3 s), an emphasis pass dims every bar except the tallest per cluster (3-5 s), hold (5-6 s). Entry: bars rise from the baseline with staggered easing. Transition out: bars compress into a lime dot that wipes to the next scene.

EDITORIAL — 'Ruta del balon': an illustrative vertical football pitch drawn in thin warm-white #edf0e6 lines, with touchlines, centre circle and one goal frame at the top. A lime #c5ed74 ball enters from the bottom on a dotted slate #8ca6bf path, arcing toward the goal; at three nodes the path pulses and Spanish labels snap in: 'Goles a favor' as the ball drives upward, then 'Goles recibidos' as a second, slate ball drops toward a bottom goal mouth. STATISTICAL — 'Balance goleador': the particles settle into paired vertical bars on a shared scale in 'goles' with a common zero baseline. Two Spanish category labels, 'A favor' and 'Recibidos'; each category holds a lime bar for Tottenham Hotspur FC and a slate bar for Coventry City FC, identified by a warm-white legend using full Spanish team names. Scale maximum equals the largest value among {{home.gf}}, {{home.ga}}, {{away.gf}}, {{away.ga}}. Entry: bars rise with staggered ease-out. Transition: the axis folds away as a lime wipe carries to the next scene.

Lime #c5ed74 arcs sweep in from the edges and break against the shield face; on each impact the shield flashes lime, emits a slate #8ca6bf shockwave ring, and the Spanish heading 'Arcos en cero' stamps on with a heavy 1-frame scale pop. Left column lime for Tottenham Hotspur FC, right column slate for Coventry City FC, with a warm-white legend using full Spanish team names. prompts.title: Head-to-Head — Visual Duel into Historical Split
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 composition on charcoal #101412; the lower quarter is reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. EDITORIAL — 'Duelo central': a split-screen face-off. The left half is claimed by Tottenham Hotspur FC, with a lime #c5ed74 diagonal beam and the Spanish team label in warm-white #edf0e6 caps; the right half belongs to Coventry City FC, with a slate #8ca6bf diagonal beam and its Spanish team label. A jagged lime 'VS' bolt cracks down the centre line, shaking the frame for 2 frames; each team label lands with a heavy scale pop and a shockwave ring. Rhythmic emphasis: the beams push against each other, the centre seam flickering toward whichever side is pressing; one focal point — the contested centre seam. No numbers, no axes, no sample claims, no invented match events, no forecast language. Exit: the seam splits open like a seam of light and becomes the axis of the chart. STATISTICAL — 'Historial de cruces': a single horizontal stacked bar spans the width, its total length fixed to {{h2h.total}} partidos, annotated in Spanish as 'Muestra historica: {{h2h.total}} partidos'. Three segments share the one bar: lime for 'Victorias Tottenham Hotspur FC' tagged {{h2h.homeWins}}, warm white for 'Empates' tagged {{h2h.draws}}, slate for 'Victorias Coventry City FC' tagged {{h2h.awayWins}}. The unit 'partidos' sits at the scale head; a zero tick anchors the left edge. Source credit 'Fuente: Bzzoiro' in small slate type. A Spanish disclaimer holds beneath the bar for the whole scene: 'Historial: no es un pronostico'. Temporal stages: the bar draws left to right segment by segment (0-3 s), each segment's tag stamps on as it completes (3-4.5 s), an emphasis pass lifts the longest segment slightly and dims the rest (4.5-6 s), hold (6-7 s). Entry: segments slide in with staggered easing. Transition: the bar contracts into a lime line that whips off-screen.

prompts.title: Synthesis — Team Reveals into Goal Tension Panel
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 stage on charcoal #101412; the lower quarter remains clear for permanent yellow subtitles. EDITORIAL — 'Revelaciones': sequential team reveals with narrative emphasis. First, 'Tottenham Hotspur FC' types on letter by letter in warm-white #edf0e6 caps, underlined by a lime #c5ed74 stroke that draws left to right; after a beat of silence, 'Coventry City FC' reveals the same way with a slate #8ca6bf underline. Between them the Spanish heading 'El balance goleador' stamps on in lime with a 2-frame scale pop and a subtle camera push-in. Rhythmic emphasis: each reveal lands on the beat; the previously revealed element dims to keep a single focal point. STATISTICAL — 'Tension del balance': the legend chips anchor a two-panel comparison sharing one common scale in 'goles' with a shared zero baseline. Left panel 'Tottenham Hotspur FC': a lime bar 'A favor' tagged {{home.gf}} beside a slate bar 'Recibidos' tagged {{home.ga}}. Right panel 'Coventry City FC': a lime bar 'A favor' tagged {{away.gf}} beside a slate bar 'Recibidos' tagged {{away.ga}}. Emphasis is dynamic: within each pair, outline the taller bar in lime and drop the shorter to reduced opacity, letting the grounded tension read instantly without any derived figure. Sample annotation under the panels: 'Muestra: {{home.n}} y {{away.n}} partidos'; source credit 'Fuente: Bzzoiro' in small slate type. Transition: the panels fold into a lime vertical wipe that closes the montage.
